name: Tano Mall
summary: Tano Mall is a community shopping center in Edison, New Jersey, professionally managed by Wick Companies, L.L.C. Operating daily from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM, the center serves local residents with convenient retail and service options, maintaining a strong 4.2-star rating from the community.
demographics: Tano Mall serves the diverse Edison, New Jersey community, which features a mix of middle to upper-middle income families with strong representation of Asian-American and Indian-American households. The trade area attracts shoppers seeking value-oriented retail and services, with a customer base that includes young professionals, established families, and multi-generational households. Visitors typically engage in convenience-based shopping patterns, combining errands with dining and service needs in a single trip.
description: Tano Mall is a community shopping center located at 1199 Amboy Avenue in Edison, New Jersey, managed and operated by Wick Companies, L.L.C., a full-service real estate development and property management firm. The center serves the diverse Edison community with convenient retail and service offerings, operating daily from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Wick Companies brings extensive expertise in commercial real estate development, property management, and leasing to ensure Tano Mall remains a well-maintained and accessible destination for local shoppers. With a solid 4.2-star rating from nearly 1,500 Google reviews, the center has established itself as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination. The property benefits from Wick Companies' hands-on management approach, which includes in-house construction services, professional leasing teams, and comprehensive property maintenance to serve both tenants and the surrounding community.
